scope: Uploaded frontend source only. Real Chromium source-rendering with synthetic responses; native print PDF rendering. No production deployment or business API writes.

test_method.browser: Chromium via Python Playwright; in-memory source rendering (set_content)
test_method.auth_responses: synthetic fixtures; transport and storage unit-tested separately
test_method.html2pdf_download_flow: mock renderer validates controls, clone, cancellation, timeout and save guard

not_verified: Hosted page navigation and service-worker installation/update
Live Apps Script response schema, role enforcement and transactional concurrency
Real external html2pdf/html2canvas/jsPDF download rasterization and CDN loading
Actual iOS/Android devices and native app behavior
Live GitHub Actions execution and published domain/Pages settings
Server invoice-register uniqueness, persistence, email delivery and payment collection
packaged_artifact_policy: Final distributed ZIP is extracted into a fresh directory and the source-verification and source-browser suites are rerun there; external QA receipt records that result.
